en: The image shows an old sepia-toned postcard with a photograph of a small neoclassical chapel partially obscured by large trees. The structure features columns and a triangular pediment. In the background, there are a few small houses visible on a gently sloping hill. The lower part of the postcard contains white text in a language with diacritical marks commonly used in Latvian.
